description: Frontend grouped-by-cycle presentation in BOTH places: the admin Spain tab (BotLogs.tsx SpainWatcherTab) and the per-dossier detail (application-detail). Group scans by windowId then cycleNumber with visible 'Fenêtre'/'Cycle N' headers, per-window counts, per-cycle status + scanTrace steps, and a backward-compatible 'Hors cycle' bucket for rows lacking the new ids. Depends on FEAT-001 (queries return cycleNumber/windowId + getScansForDossier) and benefits from FEAT-002 producing the data.
steps: Create artifacts/joventy/src/pages/admin/spainScanGrouping.ts: a pure, dependency-free module. Export interface SpainScanRow (the fields BotLogs rows use today PLUS cycleNumber?: number, windowId?: number). Export function groupSpainScansByCycle(scans: SpainScanRow[]): Array<{ windowId: number | null; windowLabel: string; cycleCount: number; cycles: Array<{ cycleNumber: number | null; scans: SpainScanRow[] }> }>. Rows with a windowId group under it (label = Europe/Madrid-ish HH:MM derived from windowId via new Date(windowId)); rows missing windowId go under windowId=null / windowLabel 'Hors cycle'. Within a window, group by cycleNumber desc; rows missing cycleNumber go under cycleNumber=null. Windows sorted by windowId desc (null last). Explicit return type; no any.

BotLogs.tsx: extend the inline scan row type in SpainWatcherTab's scans.map to include cycleNumber?: number and windowId?: number. Wrap the existing per-row rendering in groupSpainScansByCycle(scans): render a window header ('Fenêtre {windowLabel} — {cycleCount} cycles') then, per cycle, a 'Cycle {n}' badge (or 'Hors cycle') with the cycle's status dot, followed by the EXISTING SpainCycleSteps / detected services / detected slots / error / scanTrace / pageCaptures blocks for each scan in that cycle. Preserve the filter buttons, pagination, stats bar, and clear-history button. Keep SpainScanTraceData / parseSpainScanTrace / SpainCycleSteps as-is (field-compatible with the worker).

application-detail per-dossier Spain view: in TabBot (application-detail/index.tsx ~316-355), when app.destination is one of spain|espagne|es, render a new Spain-specific grouped-by-cycle panel ABOVE or beside the existing BotLogTimeline. Prefer a new small component artifacts/joventy/src/pages/admin/application-detail/SpainDossierCycles.tsx that useQuery(api.spainWatcher.getScansForDossier, { applicationId }) and renders via groupSpainScansByCycle (reusing the shared helper and, where practical, the same SpainCycleSteps component imported/exported from BotLogs or lifted into a shared module). Non-Spain dossiers are unaffected. Rows without cycle ids still render under 'Hors cycle'.

If SpainCycleSteps / SpainScanTraceData / parseSpainScanTrace need to be shared between BotLogs.tsx and SpainDossierCycles.tsx, lift them into a small shared module (e.g. the same spainScanGrouping.ts or a sibling spainScanTrace.tsx) and import from both, keeping the component markup identical. Do not duplicate the interface definitions divergently.
acceptance_criteria: A new pure helper groupSpainScansByCycle groups by windowId then cycleNumber, labels windows, counts cycles per window, and puts id-less rows in an 'Hors cycle' bucket.
The Spain tab (SpainWatcherTab) shows window headers with a cycle count and per-'Cycle N' sections, each cycle showing its status and its scanTrace steps; filters/pagination/stats still work.
The per-dossier detail shows the same grouped-by-cycle view for Spain dossiers via getScansForDossier; non-Spain dossiers are unchanged.
Rows without cycleNumber/windowId render without crashing (grouped under 'Hors cycle').
SpainScanTraceData stays field-compatible with the worker's WorkerSpainTrace (no divergent duplicate definitions).
verification: cd artifacts/joventy && pnpm run typecheck  (zero errors)
Manual review: groupSpainScansByCycle has no `any`, explicit return type; both views call it; id-less rows path exercised by the 'Hors cycle' bucket.
findings:
IMPLEMENTED. Files (worktree only): NEW artifacts/joventy/src/pages/admin/spainScanGrouping.ts (pure helper, no React/Convex import), NEW artifacts/joventy/src/pages/admin/spainScanTrace.tsx (lifted shared trace module), NEW artifacts/joventy/src/pages/admin/application-detail/SpainDossierCycles.tsx; MODIFIED artifacts/joventy/src/pages/admin/BotLogs.tsx + application-detail/index.tsx.

PURE HELPER (spainScanGrouping.ts): exports interface SpainScanRow (BotLogs row fields + cycleNumber?: number, windowId?: number) and groupSpainScansByCycle(scans: SpainScanRow[]): SpainWindowGroup[] with explicit return type and NO any. Groups by windowId desc (null last) then cycleNumber desc (null last). windowLabel derived from new Date(windowId).toLocaleTimeString('fr-FR',{hour,minute,timeZone:'Europe/Madrid'}). Rows missing windowId -> windowId=null / windowLabel 'Hors cycle'; within a window, rows missing cycleNumber -> cycleNumber=null (rendered 'Hors cycle'). cycleCount counts only non-null cycles.

SHARED TRACE MODULE (spainScanTrace.tsx): to avoid divergent duplication, LIFTED verbatim out of BotLogs.tsx: SpainPageCapture, SpainCaptureItem, SpainScanTraceData (kept field-compatible with the worker's WorkerSpainTrace), boolBadge, parseSpainScanTrace, SpainCycleSteps, SpainScanTraceBlock, SpainPageCapturesBlock, plus the small presentation helpers SCAN_META/formatTs/formatTsFull/relativeTime. Added SpainScanRowBody (the exact per-scan body previously inline in BotLogs: status badge, dossier, timestamps, screenshot, SpainCycleSteps, detected services/slots, error with local expand state, SpainScanTraceBlock, SpainPageCapturesBlock) and SpainCycleGroupedList (window header 'Fenetre HH:MM — N cycles' + per-'Cycle N'/'Hors cycle' sections with a status dot). BotLogs.tsx now imports SCAN_META/formatTsFull/relativeTime/SpainCycleGroupedList from it; the old local definitions were removed (only a pointer comment remains). No file imports the lifted symbols from BotLogs (only its default export AdminBotLogs is used, in App.tsx).

BotLogs SpainWatcherTab: the scans.map(...) manual list was replaced by <SpainCycleGroupedList scans={scans as unknown as SpainScanRow[]} />. Filters/pagination/stats bar/clear-history button all preserved untouched. Removed now-unused expandedErrors/setExpandedErrors/toggleErrorExpand (error expand lives in SpainScanRowBody).

PER-DOSSIER (application-detail): new SpainDossierCycles uses useQuery(api.spainWatcher.getScansForDossier, { applicationId, page, pageSize:50 }) and renders via SpainCycleGroupedList; has its own simple prev/next pagination. Wired into TabBot ABOVE BotLogTimeline, guarded by app.destination in {spain,espagne,es}; non-Spain dossiers unchanged.

CAST NOTE for integration/review: both call sites use `scans as unknown as SpainScanRow[]` because convex codegen was NOT run offline (FEAT-001), so api.spainWatcher.getWatcherPaginated / getScansForDossier return types do not yet carry cycleNumber/windowId and _id is the branded Id<...>. Once `npx convex dev/deploy` regenerates _generated, the double-cast could be tightened to a single `as SpainScanRow[]` or dropped, but it is harmless as-is and keeps strict/no-any.

VERIFICATION: `cd artifacts/joventy && pnpm run typecheck` -> exit 0 (zero errors). Manual: groupSpainScansByCycle has explicit return type and no any; both views call SpainCycleGroupedList -> groupSpainScansByCycle; id-less rows (no windowId/cycleNumber, i.e. all pre-FEAT-002 rows) fall into the windowId=null 'Hors cycle' window and cycleNumber=null 'Hors cycle' cycle and render without crashing.
